It is well-known for its liver-protecting properties, helping to detoxify the body and support overall liver function, which can improve digestion and energy levels. The plant also contains antioxidants that may reduce inflammation and lower the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. Incorporating milk thistle into your daily routine can enhance your immune system, promote skin health, and even support mental clarity, making it a valuable addition to a balanced lifestyle.
